rendered: The document gives no reason for withdrawing the SY trial, because the clinical trial table does not list SY as withdrawn. In SY's row of Table 1[1] (exosome carrier, KrasG12D siRNA, metastatic pancreas cancer, M.D. Anderson), the status is printed as Phase 1[2], continued on the next printed line by Phase 2[3] and then Recruiting[4]. Read together, that is a combined early-phase trial that is still recruiting. The prose agrees: SY utilizes exosomes to deliver KrasG12D siRNA[5] and is currently in the Phase 1/2 patient recruitment stage[6]. The only "Withdrawn" status in the table is on the CpG-STAT3 siRNA trial row above, not on SY's row: Phase 1 Withdrawn[7]. Neither the table nor the prose states why any trial was withdrawn, so the question's premise that SY was withdrawn is not supported by the document.[8]
